Stopwatch

A precise stopwatch with start, pause, reset and lap recording. Shows minutes, seconds and centiseconds, with a list of every lap time you record.

00:00.00

    No laps yet. Press “Lap” while the stopwatch is running.

    📖 How to use

    1. Click "Start" to begin timing.
    2. Click "Lap" while running to record the current lap time.
    3. Click "Pause" to stop the clock without losing elapsed time.
    4. Click "Reset" to clear the timer and all laps.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    How accurate is the stopwatch?

    It uses performance.now(), a high-resolution timer built into your browser, and updates about 32 times per second for smooth centisecond display.

    Does it keep working if I switch browser tabs?

    Yes — because it is timestamp-based, the stopwatch keeps correct time while you switch tabs or minimize the browser. The display only refreshes when visible.

    Are my laps saved?

    Your laps stay on the page until you click Reset. They are not saved if you reload or leave the page.
